## What you heard

Describe the seam, audible problem, and expected behavior.

## Reproduction

Revision, `mixconsole doctor`, command, seed, MixScript, and report when available.

## Source and permissions

Give track content hashes and license/source links or a synthetic generator command.
Do not upload commercial audio or model weights.

## Timing and evidence

Transition family, cue times, affected time window, and permitted audio/screenshots.
